finding.location: _check_source_direction_reversal using old sharedsource signals versus new result risk signals
finding.reason: The shared source extraction intentionally stays unchanged, but misreads risk lowering as physical supply falling. New result-only risk pressure is then incorrectly compared against that old physical sign and rejected as a source contradiction, even though the cited source explicitly states the same risk change.
finding.bounded_fix: Within result validation only compare risk objects as risk, not physical supply change. Preserve shared preparedinput/source projection bytes and actual-flow source opposite checking. Add source-risk lower/bearish and higher/bullish positive controls.
